sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: MEAN LONGWAVE TROUGH WILL REMAIN THE DOMINANT FEATURE OVER THE CONUS THROUGH THE PERIOD...WITH A WESTWARD EXPANSION OF THE TROUGH OVER THE NORTHERN/CENTRAL ROCKIES AND A SOUTHWESTWARD SHUNT OF THE UPPER RIDGE CENTERED OVER THE BAJA VICINITY. ON THE PERIPHERY OF THIS BROAD LONGWAVE TROUGH...A NUMBER OF SHORTWAVE DISTURBANCES /SOME CONVECTIVELY ENHANCED/ WILL CYCLONICALLY PIVOT OVER THE ROCKIES...TO THE ARKLATEX/MID-SOUTH...AND GREAT LAKES REGION. MULTIPLE/SLOW MOVING REMNANT FRONTAL BOUNDARIES WILL REMAIN FROM THE NORTHEAST TO THE CENTRAL/SOUTHERN PLAINS...BUT THE MAIN/REINFORCING COLD FRONT IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE WESTERN GREAT LAKES/MIDWEST/PLAINS.

sections.title: CENTRAL/SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: SEVERAL DISTURBANCES WILL SPREAD SOUTHEASTWARD OVER THE ROCKIES/ADJACENT HIGH PLAINS TODAY/TONIGHT...CHIEFLY A SHORTWAVE TROUGH CROSSING WY EARLY IN THE OVERNIGHT. TSTMS SHOULD DEVELOP AND INCREASE IN COVERAGE/INTENSITY RELATIVELY EARLY IN THE AFTERNOON...INITIALLY OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF SOUTHEAST WY/EASTERN CO INTO NORTHEAST NM...AND PERHAPS ALONG RESIDUAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES ACROSS THE IMMEDIATELY ADJACENT HIGH PLAINS GIVEN A MOIST/WEAKLY CAPPED AIRMASS. A SLIGHT SOUTHWESTWARD SHIFT OF STRONGER MID LEVEL FLOW SHOULD RESULT IN 30-40 KT OF MID LEVEL WINDS AS FAR SOUTH AS NORTHEAST/EAST CENTRAL NM BY MID/LATE AFTERNOON...WITH VEERING WIND PROFILES OTHERWISE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS/ORGANIZED MULTICELLS. SEVERE HAIL AND PERHAPS A TORNADO OR TWO WILL BE POSSIBLE THROUGH MID/LATE AFTERNOON. WITH TIME...UPSCALE GROWTH INTO ONE OR MORE SOUTH-SOUTHEAST MOVING/ORGANIZED QUASI-LINEAR CONVECTIVE SYSTEMS SEEMS LIKELY BY EARLY EVENING...WITH POTENTIAL FOR A BROADER DAMAGING WIND THREAT ACROSS THE SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS.

sections.title: ARKLATEX TO CENTRAL GULF COAST STATES/TN VALLEY
sections.text: CONVECTIVELY ENHANCED VORTICITY MAXIMA /OVER THE ARKLATEX EARLY IN THE OVERNIGHT/ IS EXPECTED TO TRANSITION EAST-NORTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE MID-SOUTH/CENTRAL GULF COAST STATES/TN VALLEY THROUGH TONIGHT AMIDST BROADER CYCLONIC LONGWAVE REGIME. AHEAD OF THESE FEATURES...THE EAST-NORTHEASTWARD DOWNSTREAM ADVECTION OF A MOISTURE-RICH AIRMASS IS EXPECTED...AS CHARACTERIZED BY AROUND 70F SURFACE DEWPOINTS AND 15+ G/KG MEAN MIXING RATIOS PER 00Z SHV/LCH/FWD/JAN OBSERVED RAOBS. FURTHERMORE...00Z NAM/GFS AND PRIOR 12Z ECMWF GUIDANCE ALL SUGGEST THAT ENHANCED LOW LEVEL WIND FIELDS /40+ KT AROUND 1 KM/ MAY ACCOMPANY THIS SHORTWAVE TROUGH/ATTENDANT SURFACE LOW. WHILE HIGH MOISTURE CONTENT/AMPLE LOW LEVEL SRH WOULD SUPPORT THE POSSIBILITY OF ISOLATED TORNADOES/DAMAGING WINDS THROUGH AROUND SUNSET...POTENTIAL CONVECTIVE FEEDBACK AND UNCERTAINTIES IN 00Z BASED NUMERICAL GUIDANCE LIMITS CONFIDENCE IN SOMEWHAT HIGHER/MORE FOCUSED TORNADO/SEVERE WIND PROBABILITIES. REGARDLESS...IF OVERNIGHT TRENDS/EARLY MORNING DATA CONFIRM THE PRESENCE OF MORE APPRECIABLE LOW LEVEL FLOW FIELDS EARLY IN THE DAY...AND SUFFICIENT CLOUD BREAKS/DOWNSTREAM HEATING ARE LIKELY...PORTIONS OF THE REGION COULD WARRANT A CATEGOR

sections.title: MIDWEST
sections.text: AMIDST A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS AND WEST-SOUTHWESTERLY MOISTURE INFLUX...SCATTERED TSTMS SHOULD DIURNALLY INCREASE DURING THE AFTERNOON ALONG THE EAST-SOUTHEASTWARD ADVANCING COLD FRONT/PREFRONTAL TROUGH. WHILE MAINLY ISOLATED SEVERE WIND/HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGEST STORMS THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING FROM LOWER MI TO THE OZARKS/MIDDLE MS VALLEY...LESS THAN OPTIMALLY TIMED LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT AND/OR MODEST VERTICAL SHEAR /GENERALLY 25 KT OR LESS/ SUGGEST POTENTIAL FOR AN ORGANIZED/APPRECIABLE SEVERE EVENT IS LIMITED.

sections.title: NORTHERN INTERMOUNTAIN WEST
sections.text: WITH A RELATIVELY MOIST AIRMASS IN PLACE /0.75 TO 1 INCH PWS PER SPOKANE AND GREAT FALLS 00Z OBSERVED RAOBS/...AMPLIFYING/SOUTH-SOUTHEASTWARD DIGGING SHORTWAVE TROUGH FROM THE WESTERN CANADIAN PROVINCES TO THE NORTHERN ROCKIES SHOULD CONTRIBUTE TO SOME STRONGER/SEVERE TSTMS OVER THE NORTHERN GREAT DIVIDE VICINITY THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. ..GUYER/LEVIT.. 07/28/2009

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: BROAD CYCLONIC FLOW WILL PREVAIL OVER MUCH OF THE LWR 48 THIS PERIOD AS SW U.S. RDG IS SUPPRESSED FARTHER S INTO SONORA...AND RDG PERSISTS ALONG THE BC CST. NUMEROUS SHORTWAVE FEATURES WITHIN THE CYCLONIC FLOW WILL ONCE AGAIN STRONGLY GOVERN DIURNALLY-ENHANCED STORM DEVELOPMENT. THE MOST NOTEWORTHY SUCH FEATURES IN SATELLITE AND VWP DATA ATTM APPEAR TO BE OVER ID...THE CNTRL RCKYS...NE TX...AND LK SUPERIOR. OTHER THAN SE-MOVING COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH LK SUPERIOR DISTURBANCE /NOW EXTENDING FROM THE UPR GRT LKS THROUGH THE MID MS VLY TO THE CNTRL PLNS/...SURFACE FEATURES WILL REMAIN WEAK. A DIFFUSE SFC WAVE NOW OVER NE TX SHOULD TRACK NE INTO AR/TN/KY LATER TODAY/TONIGHT.

sections.title: CNTRL/SRN RCKYS AND HI PLNS
sections.text: ELONGATED/COMPLEX DISTURBANCE NOW OVER THE NRN GRT BASIN/CNTRL RCKYS SHOULD CONTINUE ESE ACROSS THE REMAINDER OF THE CNTRL RCKYS AND ADJACENT HI PLNS THROUGH EARLY WED. TSTMS ASSOCIATED WITH THIS FEATURE SHOULD INCREASE IN COVERAGE/INTENSITY BY EARLY AFTN FROM SRN/ERN WY SSE INTO CNTRL/ERN CO AND NE NM. OTHER STORMS MAY FORM/INTENSIFY ALONG EXISTING OUTFLOW BOUNDARIES AND/OR IN POST-FRONTAL UPSLOPE FLOW EWD INTO THE CNTRL HI PLNS. GRADUAL EXPANSION OF LARGE SCALE TROUGH WILL ALLOW MODERATE /35-40 KT/ NWLY MID LVL FLOW TO SAG SWD INTO NRN/ERN NM BY LATE IN THE DAY...YIELDING DEEPLY VEERING WIND PROFILES DESPITE WEAK LOW LVL FLOW. COUPLED WITH MODERATE SFC HEATING AND PW VALUES AOA 1 INCH...SETUP SHOULD SUPPORT SUSTAINED MULTICELLS AND SCTD SUPERCELLS. THESE WILL POSE A THREAT FOR HAIL AND PERHAPS A COUPLE TORNADOES...ESPECIALLY FROM MID AFTN TO EARLY EVE. LATER THIS EVE...UPSCALE GROWTH INTO ONE OR MORE SSE-MOVING MCSS APPEARS LIKELY AS SWD SAG OF THE WLYS RESULTS IN A STRENGTHENED LLJ. THESE SYSTEMS MAY BE ACCOMPANIED BY A BROADER DMGG WIND THREAT OVER THE SRN HI PLNS THROUGH LATE TONIGHT.

sections.title: ARKLATEX INTO TN VLY/SRN APPALACHIANS
sections.text: IMPULSE NOW OVER NE TX APPEARS TO HAVE BECOME CONVECTIVELY- ENHANCED AS SYSTEM LLJ TAPPED VERY MOISTURE-RICH ENVIRONMENT OVER E TX/LA. DESPITE WARM MID LVL TEMPERATURES...TSTMS SHOULD CONTINUE TO DEVELOP INVOF THE VORT AS THE SYSTEM MOVES GENERALLY ENE ACROSS THE TN VLY/SRN APPALACHIANS...ON PERIPHERY OF LARGER SCALE TROUGH. WITH CONTINUED ACCESS TO MOISTURE-RICH AIR /PW AOA 2.25 INCHES AND SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE 70S/...SYSTEM MAY DEVELOP A WEAK MCV-LIKE CIRCULATION AND A CORRESPONDING INCREASE IN LOW LVL SLY FLOW/LOW LVL SHEAR. THUS...A THREAT FOR ISOLD TORNADOES AND/OR WET MICROBURSTS MAY DEVELOP...ESPECIALLY IN/DOWNSTREAM FROM AREAS THAT RECEIVE SFC HEATING. UNCERTAINTIES REMAIN REGARDING THE LIKELIHOOD OF THE ABOVE SCENARIO GIVEN THE WEAK LOW TO MID LVL LAPSE RATES PRESENT IN THE OBSERVED 12Z SOUNDINGS AT KSHV AND KJAN. NEVERTHELESS...THE APPRECIABLE OVERNIGHT INCREASE IN LOW LVL FLOW/SHEAR AT KSHV...AND THE EXPECTATION OF AT LEAST MODEST HEATING ACROSS LA AND SRN MS LATER TODAY...SUGGESTS THAT INTRODUCTION OF A CONDITIONAL SLGT RISK FORECAST IS WARRANTED.

sections.title: MI/IND TO IL/MO
sections.text: COLD FRONT ASSOCIATED WITH LK SUPERIOR UPR IMPULSE WILL SERVE AS A FOCUS FOR DIURNALLY-ENHANCED STORMS FROM LWR MI SW INTO THE MID MS VLY/OZARKS. DEEP SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR ORGANIZED AND SUSTAINED STORMS IN MI...BUT WILL DECREASE SUBSTANTIALLY WITH SW EXTENT INTO MO. AT THE SAME TIME...INSTABILITY WILL BE CORRESPONDINGLY GREATER OVER MO..IL...AND IND /WHERE SBCAPE MAY LOCALLY EXCEED 2000 J PER KG/...THAN IN MI /WHERE VALUES SHOULD REMAIN AROUND 1000 J PER KG/. LARGE SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT ALONG THE BOUNDARY WILL BE LIMITED AS LK SUPERIOR TROUGH MOVES NE INTO ONTARIO AND NEXT UPSTREAM NRN STREAM IMPULSE REMAINS WELL TO THE N IN MN/WI. THUS...WHILE ISOLD SVR WIND/HAIL EVENTS WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGEST STORMS...POTENTIAL FOR AN ORGANIZED/APPRECIABLE SVR EVENT APPEARS LIMITED.

sections.title: NRN INTERMOUNTAIN RGN/NRN RCKYS
sections.text: RELATIVELY MOIST /0.75 TO 1 INCH PW/ AIR IS IN PLACE FROM THE NRN RCKYS INTO WA...INVOF COMPLEX SHORTWAVE TROUGH EXTENDING FROM ID NNW INTO BC/AB. COMBINATION OF ASCENT/DESTABILIZATION WITH THE UPR DISTURBANCE...AND SFC HEATING...SHOULD SUPPORT FAIRLY NUMEROUS AFTN/EVE STORMS ALONG AND AHEAD OF ASSOCIATED COLD FRONT MOVING MAINLY SWD ACROSS ERN WA...NRN ID...AND WRN/CNTRL MT. DEEP SHEAR WILL BE MODEST...BUT DEGREE OF INSTABILITY SUGGESTS POSSIBILITY FOR A FEW PULSE STORMS WITH SVR WIND/HAIL THROUGH EARLY EVE. ..CORFIDI/GRAMS.. 07/28/2009

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: BROAD UPPER TROUGH...CENTERED OVER THE MS VALLEY...WILL RESIDE OVER MUCH OF THE NATION THIS FORECAST PERIOD. SEVERAL SHORTWAVE TROUGHS EMBEDDED WITH THE CYCLONIC FLOW ALOFT WILL AID IN PRIMARILY DIURNALLY-ENHANCED STORMS. THE EXCEPTION IS WITH A PERSISTENT AND SLOW MOVING IMPULSE CURRENTLY MOVING THROUGH THE ARKLATEX...WHERE CONVECTION PERSISTED THROUGH THE NIGHT AND INTO THE MORNING HOURS. AT THE SURFACE...A SEWD MOVING COLD FRONT WILL SHIFT THROUGH THE GREAT LAKES/OH VALLEY...IN ASSOCIATION WITH A STRONGER UPPER WAVE MOVING THROUGH THE NRN GREAT LAKES. SRN PORTION OF FRONT FROM MO SWWD INTO THE TX PANHANDLE WILL MOVE SEWD...AND EXTEND ROUGHLY NEAR A STL-END-LBB LINE BY LATE AFTERNOON.

sections.title: ARKLATEX EWD INTO THE SRN APPALACHIANS
sections.text: UPPER IMPULSE OVER THE ARKLATEX HAS THUS FAR BEEN SLOW TO MOVE EWD MORE RAPIDLY...LIKELY DUE TO ANOTHER DISTURBANCE...ON WV IMAGERY...THAT APPEARED TO MERGE AND STRENGTHEN SYSTEM EARLIER THIS MORNING. FORWARD SPEED MAY INCREASE AS OTHER WAVES BEHIND IT MOVE SEWD AND AID IN KICKING THE SYSTEM A LITTLE FASTER EWD. WIND PROFILES LOCATED CLOSE TO THIS UPPER SYSTEM ARE FORECAST TO REMAIN RELATIVELY STRONG THROUGH TONIGHT. THOUGH CONSIDERABLE CLOUDINESS IS LIKELY TO REDUCE THE AMOUNT OF DAYTIME HEATING AHEAD OF THE SYSTEM...A WARM AND MORE UNSTABLE AIR MASS IMMEDIATELY SOUTH OF THE CONVECTION WILL FUEL THE STORMS. THOUGH MODE AND EVOLUTION OF CONVECTION IS EXPECTED TO BE MIXED THROUGH THE PERIOD...THE VERTICAL SHEAR WILL SUPPORT BOTH SUPERCELLS/ISOLATED TORNADOES AS WELL AS BOW ECHOES WITH WIND DAMAGE. THIS THREAT IS EXPECTED TO SPREAD INTO MS THIS AFTERNOON AND POSSIBLY AS FAR EAST AS AL AND NWRN GA TONIGHT.

sections.title: WESTERN PORTIONS OF THE CENTRAL/SRN PLAINS
sections.text: MORNING WV IMAGERY SHOWS FRAGMENTED UPPER WAVES MOVING SEWD FROM THE WY/NEB BORDER SEWD INTO NRN OK. HOWEVER...ONGOING CONVECTION OVER NRN KS AND MODEL FORECAST SUGGEST SYSTEM NEAR THE WY/NEB BORDER SHOULD BE THE MAIN FEATURE FOR CONVECTION ACROSS THE CENTRAL/SRN PLAINS. SUNNY CONDITIONS AND WARMING/DESTABILIZING BOUNDARY LAYER THIS MORNING WAS OCCURRING OVER SERN CO/SWRN KS/NWRN OK AND THE TX PANHANDLE. ACROSS THIS AREA...THE BEST OVERLAP OF LOW LEVEL FRONTAL CONVERGENCE...WARMING AND LIFT ASSOCIATED WITH UPPER WAVE WOULD BE OVER SWRN KS/NWRN OK AND TX PANHANDLE. OTHER STORMS ARE LIKELY TO DEVELOP OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF SERN CO/NERN NM WHERE STRONG HEATING OF MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER WILL OCCUR. AFTER STORMS FORM...MODERATE INSTABILITY AND 30-40 KT DEEP LAYER SHEAR SHOULD SUSTAIN MULTICELLS AND POSSIBLY A SUPERCELL OR TWO. THE MAIN THREAT WILL BE HAIL...THOUGH THE WIND THREAT WILL BE HIGHER THIS EVENING AS STORMS CONSOLIDATE INTO ONE OR TWO LINEAR CLUSTERS.

sections.title: LOWER MI/IND TO IL/MO
sections.text: SCATTERED CONVECTION WAS LOCATED NEAR THE COLD FRONT AND WILL CONTINUE TO SERVE AS FOCUS FOR STORMS FROM LOWER MI SWWD INTO THE MID MS VALLEY/OZARKS. WHILE DEEP SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR ORGANIZED AND SUSTAINED STORMS IN MI...INSTABILITY WILL BE WEAK. FROM INDIANA TO MO...THE INSTABILITY WILL BE MODERATE TO STRONG...BUT THE SHEAR WILL BE WEAK...DUE TO UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND PROFILES. ALTHOUGH ISOLATED SEVERE WIND/HAIL EVENTS APPEAR POSSIBLE...THE POTENTIAL FOR A MORE ORGANIZED SVR EVENT APPEARS LOW.

sections.title: NRN INTERMOUNTAIN/ROCKIES
sections.text: RELATIVELY MOIST /0.75 TO 1 INCH PW/ AIR IS IN PLACE FROM THE NRN ROCKIES AHEAD OF ANOTHER SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING SEWD TOWARD THE CONTINENTAL DIVIDE. THE SHEAR/INSTABILITY APPEARS MOST FAVORABLE FOR SEVERE STORMS ESPECIALLY ACROSS WA...THOUGH MODEL RUNS APPEAR TO DEVELOP CONVECTION IN ASSOCIATION WITH THIS SYSTEM OVER WRN MT. INSTABILITY IN WRN MT WILL BE MARGINAL FOR SEVERE...THOUGH SHEAR SHOULD BE STRONG ENOUGH FOR A FEW SVR STORMS LATE AFTERNOON/EVENING. ..IMY/GARNER.. 07/28/2009

sections.title: CNTRL/SRN PLAINS
sections.text: AS OF 18Z...PRIMARY COLD FRONT EXTENDED FROM S OF MKC SWWD TO ICT TO LBL TO TAD. DIABATIC HEATING COUPLED WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE 50S TO LOW/MID 60S AND ERN EDGE OF STEEPER MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES HAVE CONTRIBUTED TO A MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIR MASS WITH MLCAPE OF 1500-2500 J/KG. COMBINATION OF FRONTAL FORCING AND GLANCING INFLUENCE OF MIDLEVEL IMPULSE OVER NEB/KS ARE RESULTING IN SCATTERED TSTM DEVELOPMENT ALONG THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF SERN CO/NERN NM. CURRENT TUCUMCARI NM PROFILER INDICATES THAT A GRADUAL STRENGTHENING OF WINDS HAS OCCURRED TODAY ABOVE 5-6 KM...RESULTING IN 40-50 KT OF DEEP-LAYER SHEAR ACROSS THE PLAINS OF SERN CO/NERN NM. AS SUCH...SETUP WILL FAVOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF ORGANIZED STORMS /INCLUDING SUPERCELLS/ WITH THE THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS A TORNADO OR TWO. MORE DISCRETE STORMS WILL LIKELY CONSOLIDATE INTO ONE OR MORE CLUSTERS TONIGHT WITH A CONTINUED THREAT FOR HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS ACROSS WRN PARTS OF TX AND OK. ADDITIONAL STRONG/SEVERE TSTMS WILL BE POSSIBLE FARTHER E ALONG OR IN IMMEDIATE WAKE OF FRONT INTO S-CNTRL KS/N-CNTRL OK. SEE MCD 1702 FOR ADDITIONAL NEAR TERM GUIDANCE.

sections.title: LOWER MS VALLEY INTO CNTRL GULF STATES
sections.text: NOCTURNAL MCS WHICH MATURED EARLIER TODAY OVER THE ARKLATEX HAS SINCE DECAYED WITH NUMEROUS TSTMS DEVELOPING ALONG CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW AND/OR DIFFERENTIAL HEATING BOUNDARIES. 18Z JAN SOUNDING INDICATES THAT AIR MASS IS MOIST AND MODERATELY UNSTABLE WITH MLCAPE OF AROUND 2000 J/KG. BASED ON AREA PROFILERS AND VWPS...IT APPEARS THAT STRONGER WIND FIELDS ASSOCIATED WITH MIDLEVEL VORTICITY MAXIMUM WILL REMAIN GENERALLY N OF THE I-20 CORRIDOR THROUGH TONIGHT. SHOULD POCKETS OF STRONGER DESTABILIZATION OCCUR WITHIN THIS ZONE OF STRONGER SHEAR...SOME POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR MARGINAL SUPERCELL AND/OR BOWING STRUCTURES CAPABLE OF DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO OR TWO.

sections.title: 4-CORNERS REGION
sections.text: SCATTERED TSTMS HAVE DEVELOPED WITH MIDLEVEL MOIST PLUME /PER WV IMAGERY/ IN A STEEP LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT WITH MODEST /40 KT/ MIDLEVEL FLOW. A FEW OF THE STRONGER STORMS WILL BE CAPABLE OF LOCALLY DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. SEE MCD 1701 FOR ADDITIONAL NEAR TERM GUIDANCE.

sections.title: MID MS VALLEY INTO SRN GREAT LAKES
sections.text: SCATTERED TSTMS DEVELOPING ALONG/AHEAD OF FRONT WILL POSE AN ISOLATED WIND/HAIL THREAT INTO THIS EVENING. REGIONAL VWP/PROFILER DATA INDICATE THAT MARGINAL VERTICAL SHEAR SHOULD LIMIT A MORE ORGANIZED SEVERE THREAT. ..MEAD.. 07/28/2009 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1129 AM CDT TUE JUL 28 2009/

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS ACROSS THE SOUTHERN PLAINS
sections.text: ...SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS TO OK... ONGOING SCATTERED QUASI-DISCRETE/EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS...MAINLY ACROSS EASTERN NM/FAR SOUTHEAST CO AND OK/TX PANHANDLES...WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP GENERALLY SOUTH-SOUTHEASTWARD ACROSS THE SOUTHERN HIGH PLAINS THIS EVENING. SEVERE HAIL WILL CONTINUE TO BE POSSIBLE...AND A BROADER/MORE ORGANIZED WIND DAMAGE POTENTIAL MAY EVOLVE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS MAINLY ACROSS THE TX PANHANDLE AND NORTHWEST/WEST TX VIA ONE OR MORE SEVERE MCS/S. FARTHER EAST...ANOTHER COMPLEX OF TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO POSE A SEVERE HAIL/WIND RISK ACROSS PORTIONS OF CENTRAL/EASTERN OK...MAINLY OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS.

sections.title: CENTRAL GULF COAST STATES TO TN VALLEY/CAROLINAS
sections.text: MID LEVEL TROUGH OVER THE EAST CENTRAL GULF COAST STATES WILL CONTINUE TO ADVANCE NORTHEASTWARD TOWARD THE SOUTHERN APPALACHIANS BY EARLY WEDNESDAY AMIDST A BROADER LONGWAVE CYCLONIC REGIME. ENHANCED LOW LEVEL WIND FIELDS /30+ KT 1 KM/ IN CONJUNCTION WITH THIS SHORTWAVE TROUGH COULD YET SUPPORT A TORNADO OR BOUT OF WIND DAMAGE THIS EVENING. HOWEVER...ANY SUCH THREAT SHOULD BE BRIEF/LOCALIZED IN NATURE GIVEN WEAK BUOYANCY AND NOCTURNALLY INCREASING CINH IMPLIED FROM REGIONAL 00Z OBSERVED RAOBS. FARTHER EAST...ONGOING SEVERE THREAT ACROSS THE CAROLINAS SHOULD DIMINISH OVER THE NEXT HOUR OR TWO. ..GUYER.. 07/29/2009
